accepted_fact_texts: Sheep are amazing at remembering faces—they can recognize and remember up to 50 different sheep and humans for over two years!
Sheep have super-wide vision that stretches almost all the way around their heads, so they can see behind themselves without turning around!

problems: Duplicate fact: the first sentence restates the already-accepted card's underlying fact (sheep remember ~50 individual faces) with only minor rewording; the added bleat-voice detail is a secondary clause and does not make the card a genuinely different fact. If the voice-recognition idea is worth keeping, rewrite the card to be solely about individual bleat recognition and drop the face-memory/50 claim entirely.
